text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a model learns from training data that includes correct answers. For example, you can show a computer many emails marked as "spam" or "not spam." The model studies this data and finds patterns. After training, it can make predictions about new emails it has never seen before. The accuracy of these predictions depends on the quality and amount of training data. Good data usually leads to better results. Machine learning is now used in many areas, such as medicine, finance, and online shopping.
